Planning Document: docs/dcps/INNERWEST/Marrickville/Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9 18 Dulwich Hill Station North.pdf

Clause 9.18.1 - heritage (heritage): The precinct contains part of the South Dulwich Hill  Heritage Conservation Area.

Clause 9.18.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect and preserve the identified period buildings within the precinct and 
encourage their sympathetic alteration or restoration.

Clause 9.18.2 - height_limit (development_control): To maintain dis tinctly single storey streetscapes that exist within the precinct.

Clause 9.18.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect groups or runs of buildings which retain their original built form 
including roof forms, original detailing and finishes.

Clause 9.18.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect  significant streetscape s and/or public domain elements within the 
precinct including landscaping, fencing, open space, sandstone kerbing and 
guttering, views and vistas and prevailing subdivision patterns.

Clause 9.18.2 - zoning (land_use_zoning): To preserve the predominantly low density residen tial character of the precinct.

Clause 9.18.2 - environmental_protection (environmental_protection): To ensure that  new  development considers all potential impacts to biodiversity.

Clause 9.18.2 - parking (development_control): To ensure that the provision and location of off -street car parking does not 
adversely impact the amenity of the precinct.
